notes.title: Gunslinger Nova Steam Release!
notes.notes:
Update ver 1.006
- adjusted projectiles so trails do not destroy with projectile
- added trails to small plutonium slug and medium plasma bolt
- projectile trail size adjustments
- added pings to pre-battle countdown
- added help screen
- reduced death VFX particle emissions and lifetime
- release on Steam!
